name: Pactiv Evergreen - Temple TX Distribution Center

fieldNotes.truckGate: The DC has full chain-link perimeter fencing (with dark privacy mesh) confirmed in Street View (2026-04). The entrance driveway off Pegasus Drive (marked with a '3776' address sign on the road) reads as an open / uncontrolled driveway opening in the fence — no barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point checkpoint structure was visible in Street View or z20 satellite. Marked false; flagged uncertain (the fence may carry a swing gate that is normally open).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the entrance. The small structure at the building's NE corner is an office/maintenance building set against the warehouse, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — no truck gate confirmed, so remoteGs does not apply.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard inside the fence on the NE and west sides gives ample internal queue/holding room before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved yard from the entrance to the dock faces — well over 3 trucks of stacking room.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide unfenced paved yard at the entrance; ample room to add a dedicated express/bypass lane if a controlled gate were installed.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Massive distribution warehouse with long continuous dock banks: ~25-30 doors with trailers on the west face along the rail line, plus a further dock bank with dock canopies on the NE face. Estimated 50+ doors total. Low-confidence overhead count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop/parking on the NE and west yards holds an estimated 25-50 trailers; honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on different building faces (west/rail face vs. NE face) imply physically separate ship/receive flows; functional split not verifiable from imagery.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: One dominant large distribution warehouse building plus a small ancillary structure — treated as a single facility, not a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in the imagery.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage yard areas with parked trailers are present alongside active dock staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line / spur runs N-S directly along the west face of the warehouse with a long string of rail cars parked on it (visible z17/z18) — the DC is rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: The DC sits within Temple TX's developed industrial corridor on Pegasus Drive, adjacent to the Pactiv plant, an electrical substation, and continuous industrial development. Urban setting.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the perimeter box (~70 acres) — a large single-warehouse distribution property.
